evidence.note: nbf is 600s after the evaluation time, beyond the 5-minute skew limit.
The token was issued at 'now' but nbf is 10 minutes later, so the OP is setting nbf ahead of issuance.
Not expired, so the failure is only the not-before check.

output.fix: Fix the new OP's token configuration so nbf is set to the issue time (nbf <= iat) rather than 10 minutes ahead. Check for a not-before offset or clock drift on the OP's signing hosts, and sync those hosts' clocks with NTP. On the SP side, keep clock skew tolerance at 5 minutes or less. Don't raise it to cover the 10-minute offset, and don't skip the nbf check. Until the OP is fixed, clients can retry once the nbf time has passed.

alternatives.why_not: The header uses RS256 with a kid that is present in the JWKS, so there is no algorithm problem.
iss matches the configured issuer exactly.
